title: The One-Year Deal
description: Damien Moretti is the coldest CEO in the country, raised to trust no one after his parents' deaths left him fighting off relatives for his own inheritance. Elena Rossi just wants to keep her cupcake stall alive. When Damien's grandmother offers to fund Elena's struggling business in exchange for one year of pretending to be his girlfriend, Elena has no idea what she's agreeing to — or what Damien already suspects about her.
